name: Respuesta login
Preparar SELECT por IMEI
SELECT pending-cmd por IMEI
query:
SELECT dpc.device_id, dpc.cmd_json, dpc.created_at
FROM ghostkey.device_pending_cmd dpc
JOIN tc_devices d ON d.id = dpc.device_id
WHERE d.uniqueid = $1 AND dpc.applied_at IS NULL;

name: Respuesta (cmd o vacio)
Preparar UPDATE ack
UPDATE applied_at + synced
query:
WITH dev AS (
    SELECT id FROM tc_devices WHERE uniqueid = $1
),
upd AS (
    UPDATE ghostkey.device_pending_cmd
    SET applied_at = NOW()
    WHERE device_id = (SELECT id FROM dev) AND applied_at IS NULL
    RETURNING device_id
)
UPDATE ghostkey.device_config
SET synced = TRUE
WHERE device_id = (SELECT device_id FROM upd)
RETURNING device_id;

name: Respuesta (con defaults)
Validar y preparar UPSERT
UPSERT device_config
query:
INSERT INTO ghostkey.device_config (device_id, mot_thr, mot_dur, report_interval_s, cooldown_s, heartbeat_h, batt_alarm_pct, ap_pass, synced, updated_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, FALSE, NOW())
ON CONFLICT (device_id) DO UPDATE SET
    mot_thr = EXCLUDED.mot_thr,
    mot_dur = EXCLUDED.mot_dur,
    report_interval_s = EXCLUDED.report_interval_s,
    cooldown_s = EXCLUDED.cooldown_s,
    heartbeat_h = EXCLUDED.heartbeat_h,
    batt_alarm_pct = EXCLUDED.batt_alarm_pct,
    ap_pass = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.ap_pass, ghostkey.device_config.ap_pass),
    synced = FALSE,
    updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING *;

name: Respuesta exitosa
Encolar comando pendiente
UPSERT device_pending_cmd
query:
INSERT INTO ghostkey.device_pending_cmd (device_id, cmd_json, created_at, applied_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, NOW(), NULL)
ON CONFLICT (device_id) DO UPDATE SET
    cmd_json = EXCLUDED.cmd_json,
    created_at = NOW(),
    applied_at = NULL;
